facts.value: Discover new cultures and broaden your perspectives – with a study abroad experience during your studies, as an internship, or a job in research.

You can experience the world with a study abroad or ERASMUS program! Improve your language skills, get to know new cultures, and gain valuable international experience for your success in the job market.
Teaching positions abroad are possible at many partner universities of Goethe University.
If you would like to complete an internship abroad, we have compiled information about searching, organizing, and funding international internships as well as important application deadlines.
Students in teacher training can find all information regarding internships abroad at the Academy for Educational Research and Teacher Education (ABL).
Here you will find helpful information about the implementation of the ERASMUS program and support for departmental cooperation as well as snippets for your website on the topic of International.
Here, administrative and technical staff at Goethe University can find information about possible stays abroad.
